name: Bolo Fekal
features: dark skin, short black hair, dark eyes, West African features, athletic build, mature face, visible wrinkles, distinguished look, light stubble
bio: He comes from poverty. He's seen poverty. His look tells everything you need to know about his life. Now he races... Against the life, against the destiny... Who knows! A mysterious driver whose unusual name belies serious talent. Bolo's race pace in the final laps is devastating.
